title: Reverse Logistics Gujarat & Maharashtra | Vidhi Transport
description: Reverse logistics for accepted rejected goods, returns and reusable industrial packaging across Gujarat and Maharashtra, with document-led coordination.

hero.title: Reverse Logistics
intro: Coordinated return movement for rejected goods, reusable packaging and industrial materials across the operating network.

sections.title: Reverse movement with documented instructions.
sections.subtitle: Share the operating details.
intro: Reverse Logistics moves accepted goods or packaging back from the consignee, distributor, branch or project location to a nominated facility. Typical requirements include rejected consignments, returnable packaging and reusable industrial containers.

Return movements require clear ownership, condition, documentation and delivery instructions. Vidhi Transport coordinates the agreed route after reviewing the material, packaging and acceptance requirements.

cards.title: What this service can include
list: Return movement for accepted rejected or undelivered goods
Reusable drum, carboy, pallet and packaging return support
Pickup coordination from consignee or nominated location
Linkage with forward freight planning where agreed

sections.title: Frequently asked questions.
intro: These answers explain the usual planning approach. Share the exact cargo and route for a shipment-specific response.

faqs.a: It can include accepted rejected goods, undelivered consignments, reusable packaging and industrial return materials moving back to an agreed destination.

faqs.q: Can empty drums or carboys be returned?
faqs.a: Properly prepared reusable drums, carboys or other packaging may be considered after the material history, condition, documentation and route are reviewed.

faqs.q: What documents are required for a return shipment?
faqs.a: Requirements vary by material and transaction. Share the return authorization, invoice or delivery references and any cargo-specific documents for review.

faqs.q: Can forward and return movements be planned together?
faqs.a: Where route and operational conditions permit, the team can review forward and reverse requirements as one coordinated movement plan.
